notes: Five of seven pre-registered expectations held. W3 refuted (sign): wind raises the foil crossover 700->706 W at CdA 0.1, 818->841 W at 0.4, though it costs the slow monohull the most 30 W range (-2.21%/-8.23%). W5 refuted (SWATH/catamaran ratios move >1% at larger CdA). 200 W scope holds in all 24 scenario rows and 972 foil cases. Post hoc diagnostics marked in script.
